brief: 5 content tools that quietly replaced a $5K/month creator agency.

slots.desc1: AI writing partner that drafts scripts, captions, and long-form in seconds.
slots.desc2: Drag-and-drop design suite for thumb-stopping social assets and carousels.
slots.desc3: Edit video by editing text; auto-removes filler words and adds captions.
slots.desc4: Queue and publish across every channel with one calm dashboard.
slots.desc5: All-in-one content brain: calendar, briefs, scripts, and approval flows.

slots.toolTagline: An AI research assistant that writes like a senior copywriter on demand.
slots.bigStatement: Claude turns a blank page into publish-ready scripts and hooks in under 3 minutes.
slots.use1Body: Drop a topic and get ten scroll-stopping hooks in seconds.
slots.use2Body: Turn a bullet outline into a full voice-over script instantly.
slots.use3Body: Write a week of carousel captions with tone-matched variants.

slots.toolTagline: The design co-pilot that turns non-designers into brand-ready visual editors.
slots.bigStatement: Canva replaces a $3K designer with templates, AI resize, and one-click brand kits.
slots.use1Body: Build multi-slide carousels from text prompts in under five minutes.
slots.use2Body: Save fonts, colors, and logos so every asset stays perfectly on-brand.
slots.use3Body: Repurpose one design into Stories, posts, and banners instantly.

slots.toolTagline: A text-based video editor that edits footage by simply deleting words.
slots.bigStatement: Descript cuts raw footage into publishing-ready videos without ever touching a timeline.
slots.use1Body: Auto-detect and delete every um, ah, and pause in one click.
slots.use2Body: Generate animated subtitles styled to your brand in seconds.
slots.use3Body: Fix audio mistakes by typing new text in your own cloned voice.

slots.toolTagline: The calmest way to schedule, publish, and analyze every social channel.
slots.bigStatement: Buffer queues a month of content across platforms while you sleep or build.
slots.use1Body: Drag drafts into a visual calendar and auto-publish at peak times.
slots.use2Body: Tailor captions and crops for each platform from one composer.
slots.use3Body: Reply to comments and DMs across networks without switching tabs.

slots.toolTagline: The content command center where strategy, drafts, and deadlines actually live.
slots.bigStatement: Notion replaces spreadsheets and Slack with one content brain the whole team shares.
slots.use1Body: Plan topics, assign owners, and track status from idea to shipped.
slots.use2Body: Generate structured briefs with hooks, angles, and asset links.
slots.use3Body: Store scripts, brand rules, and final files in linked databases.

slots.toolTagline: An AI image engine that generates campaign-ready visuals from simple prompts.
slots.bigStatement: Midjourney delivers thumbnails and hero art that outperform stock in under 60 seconds.
slots.use1Body: Generate scroll-stopping YouTube and blog thumbnails on brand every time.
slots.use2Body: Create unique article headers and carousel covers without a photoshoot.
slots.use3Body: Lock a visual aesthetic with style codes and character consistency.

slots.body: Steal this exact 6-tool stack and start shipping content that converts without the retainer.
